comment: The frequency jack is exponential, one volt per doubling, and is scaled by the trim knob before being added to the knob; the sum is floored at -8 (LFO1.cpp:501). It is called cv rather than pitch because it is a rate control, per the family ruling in STYLE.md. The RNG, PWM and MOD jacks are mono port widgets and only channel 0 is read, even though the module's other jacks are polyphonic.
